name: benchmark_storyboard_mock
description: Acceptance-oriented benchmark run covering alignment, identity consistency, and panel sequencing.

params.style_prompt: black and white manga screentone, cinematic line art

params.prompt_hint: readable panel composition, clear silhouette separation

prompts.prompt: A black-and-white manga panel showing two teenagers facing each other on a windy rooftop at sunset, one holding a wooden staff and the other in a defensive stance, dramatic shadows and strong screentone shading
prompts.negative_prompt: blurry, low contrast, malformed hands, duplicate limbs

prompts.prompt: Manga close-up of Hiro, a 16-year-old boy with messy dark hair, a small cut on his left cheek, school uniform collar open, determined expression, black-and-white screentone shading
prompts.negative_prompt: different hair color, different scar position, blurry eyes, malformed face

prompts.prompt: Panel 3 of the same manga sequence: Akira swings a wooden staff and Hiro reacts, dynamic action panel with motion lines, impact emphasis, and preserved character identity from prior panels
prompts.negative_prompt: static pose, duplicate limbs, inconsistent characters, muddy line art
